question.text: A PMS investor realises equity LTCG of Rs. 30 lakh in a financial year (post Jul 2024). The applicable tax is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Post-July 2024, equity LTCG above Rs. 1,25,000 is taxed at 12.5%. Taxable LTCG = 30,00,000 - 1,25,000 = 28,75,000; tax = 28,75,000 * 12.5% = Rs. 3,59,375. The Trap: The other values either ignore the Rs. 1,25,000 exemption or apply an incorrect rate. Note: The Rs. 1,25,000 exemption is applied first and the 12.5% LTCG rate is then charged on the balance equity LTCG.
